## Findings and decisions

- **P3, R03 documentation:** `docs/live-state-initialization.md:236` says `name` comes from the
  baseline. `shared/contracts/characterEvaluation.ts:188` defines `DerivedBaseline` without a name,
  and `HeroLiveState` also has none. The adapter therefore needs authored character/build metadata
  as an additional input. Correct that table row before implementing the adapter; the fixture's
  literal `Grug` is valid, but does not demonstrate this mapping.
- **Decision required, Q-R-200:** `docs/live-state-initialization.md:177`–181 and
  `shared/contracts/liveState.ts:127` describe Slain as a derived label. The source
  `en/unified/md/rule/health/stamina.md:13` says ordinary Director creatures die/destroy at zero;
  it does not establish that subsequently correcting their number above zero automatically clears
  death. `docs/rules-questions-for-user.md:385` correctly records derived-versus-recorded Slain as
  an open product decision and labels the recomputation default provisional. The source review
  supports the initial false label and zero threshold; it cannot certify the correction policy as
  settled. Recommendation remains the documented recomputation for a Director correction, subject
  to the user's answer. This is not a claim that the provisional behavior contradicts a ruling.
- **Q-R-201 is properly deferred:** `docs/rules-questions-for-user.md:405` and
  `docs/live-state-initialization.md:217` preserve the detachment rule clearing XP/Victories and
  separate the unresolved fate of other live values. No corpus rule models campaign attachments.
  The one-new-hero journey needs no choice here; do not generalize first-admission initialization
  into a re-admission reset. Q-CHAR-2 similarly remains explicitly unreconciled.

## Source review and hand results

All paths in this section are relative to `vendor/steel-compendium/`. The review used only the pinned
local corpus, including `git show HEAD:path` for initially sparse book content; no online rules research.

- `en/unified/md/class/fury.md:29`–45 fixes M/A at 2, gives the remaining arrays, names Might
  potencies, states “Starting Stamina at 1st Level: 21” and “Recoveries: 10.” The selected array
  produces R/I/P = 0/1/0 under the already-labeled Q-R-101 interpretation.
- `en/unified/md/chapter/kits.md:100` adds the kit bonus to the **maximum**;
  `en/unified/md/kit/mountain.md:21` supplies +9 per echelon, and echelon 1 includes level 1.
  Hence maximum **21 + 9 × 1 = 30**. Treating the class's starting Stamina as its maximum
  contribution is supported by this combined context; no competing level-one maximum formula was
  found. The document correctly identifies that reading as interpretation rather than quoting an
  explicit class-maximum sentence.
- `en/unified/md/rule/health/recoveries.md:7` gives one-third maximum rounded down: **10
  Recoveries, recovery value 10**. `rule/health/winded.md:7` plus
  `rule/general/always-round-down.md:7` gives **winded value 15**, inclusive at exactly 15.
  Temporary Stamina does not enter either calculation (`rule/health/temporary-stamina.md:7`).
- Starting size/speed/stability (`rule/character/speed.md`), Beast Legs, Mountain and Impressive
  Horns yield **size 1M, speed 6, stability 2, saves 5+**. Disengage gives **1 square**;
  Might potency gives **0/1/2**. Mountain's table row (`chapter/kits.md:167`) gives damage
  **[0,0,4]**, no speed/distance/disengage/ranged bonuses. Soldier and the Renown/Wealth rules give
  **Renown 1 / Wealth 1**. Purchased traits total **1 + 2 = 3** points.
- `feature/fury/level-1/ferocity.md:21` removes remaining Ferocity at encounter end, and line 25
  disallows gaining it outside combat. **Creation Ferocity 0** is a reasonable explicitly labeled
  inference for an unplayed hero, not a separately printed starting value. The full file also
  allows gains in stressful situations tracked in rounds and special outside-combat ability use;
  initialization does not implement or claim to implement those features.
- The culture passages in `en/books/heroes/clean/Draw Steel Heroes.md:3217` and `:3353`, Silver
  Tongue, Soldier, Fury and Berserker grants account for the **ten listed skills**, **four language
  entries** (duplicate Caelian explicitly Q-R-100), three traits, six features and Teamwork. The
  invalid Horns + Wings fixture rejects **2 + 2 > 3** and removes purchased-trait benefits; missing
  kit reports `kit.choice` and withholds dependent maxima. Their diagnostic ids match R01.
- Fury's three ability choices, Berserker's Lines of Force, Mountain's Pain for Pain, and
  `chapter/making-a-hero.md`'s two free strikes yield exactly **seven** projected abilities:
  Brutal Slam, Out of the Way!, Thunder Roar, Lines of Force, Pain for Pain, Melee Weapon Free
  Strike, Ranged Weapon Free Strike. Costs **3/5 Ferocity**, optional Lines of Force spend,
  characteristics, keywords and tiers match their files. Pain for Pain correctly sets
  `kitBonusesIncluded: true` (`chapter/kits.md:132`); its standalone text is verified locally,
  while its snapshot content id points to the containing Mountain kit as documented.
- Hero initial state is **Stamina 30, Recoveries 10, temporary Stamina/Ferocity/surges/Victories/XP
  0, nine toggles false**. Full Stamina/Recoveries and XP zero are labeled new-hero interpretations
  supported by the class, recovery/respite, and cumulative XP rules. Neither draft save nor
  re-evaluation replenishes live state; later maxima reconciliation remains Q-CHAR-2.
- `en/unified/md/monster/goblin/statblock/goblin-warrior.md` and its S01 entry agree with the
  projection: **Stamina 15, winded 7, speed 6, stability 0, size 1S, free strike 1, M/A/R/I/P
  −2/2/0/0/−1**; initial temporary Stamina zero, conditions off, Slain false. Spear Charge is
  **+2, 3/4/5 damage**; Bury the Point is **2 Malice, +2, 5/6/7 damage**, with printed bleeding
  tiers retained; Crafty text is intact. EV 3 and Climb remain present in the verbatim stat block,
  not separate fields of this bounded engine projection.

## Verification and limits

- Focused command: `pnpm exec vitest run --project engine tests/character-derived-values.test.ts tests/live-state-initialization.test.ts`
  — **8/8 passed** after root expanded sparse checkout to include the pinned clean Heroes file.
  The initial run was **6 passed / 2 failed**, solely because both test readers require that file
  on disk; `docs/steel-compendium.md:25` documents its omission in sparse mode. Source revision and
  upstream contents did not change. This is a test-environment prerequisite, not a rules defect.
- `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.web.json` — **passed**; reviewed contract
  files contain declarations/import types only.
- Independent read-only verification, using a pinned `git show` fallback, matched **219 provenance
  and diagnostic quote occurrences across 25 source paths** and all **17 hero ability/feature
  texts**. Existing focused tests additionally compare the snapshot and Goblin projection.
- Source passage presence and fixture tests are evidence, not proof of all interpretations. No
  live database, UI journey, build activation/reconciliation, post-Slain correction, or campaign
  re-admission was exercised. These are downstream acceptance work, and the named unresolved
  choices are not silently approved by this review.
